description: This is the main entry point for a SwiftUI application called SecureSessionApp. It defines the main App struct, initializes state objects for session management and app lock handling, and sets up the root view within a window scene.

classes.name: SecureSessionApp
classes.description: Main application struct conforming to the App protocol, responsible for setting up initial app state and scene.

methods.name: body
methods.description: Defines the scene of the app, returning a WindowGroup containing the RootView with environment objects set.
